title: Kid-Friendly Kicked Mediterranean Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb stew that's accessible to kids, with a kick of horseradish and a depth of flavor from the deglazed fond.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large hot pot vessel over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and zucchini, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb back to the pot, along with the horseradish, deglazed fond, salt, and black pepper.
Pour in the lemon juice and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
